critique: The connected skill matrix occupies the central field and reads as the main workspace, but the luminous purple Keystone Ability card on the right competes strongly with the selected Nova Heart node, splitting the focal point between selection and detail. The progression lines are thin and subdued, so prerequisites are harder to scan than the glowing nodes themselves. The Aether/Blade/Ward filters are tiny and visually detached from the Celestial Discipline heading, while the left-side stats distribute attention across several boxed blocks without a strong internal order.
suggestion: Make the selected node the unmistakable bridge between tree and detail: strengthen its outgoing visual relationship to the right-hand ability panel while reducing the panel's independent glow. Increase the contrast and directional clarity of prerequisite paths, differentiating available, completed, and locked routes at a glance. Group the discipline title and filters into one header row above the matrix, then tighten the left sidebar into a clear sequence of character identity, level/XP, available points, and secondary attributes.
